title: AUTO PLACE UNIT AUTO SELL UPGRADE AND MORE GUI
features:
# ANIME EXPEDITIONS 
* AUTO PLACE UNITS
  - AUTOMATICALLY DROPS YOUR HOTBAR UNITS NEXT TO THE ENEMY PATH, NO CLICKING NEEDED
  - HAS ITS OWN HOTKEY SO YOU CAN TURN IT ON/OFF WITHOUT OPENING THE MENU

* AUTO UPGRADE UNITS
  - KEEPS UPGRADING EVERY UNIT YOU HAVE ON THE FIELD ON A LOOP
  - ALSO HAS ITS OWN HOTKEY

* AUTO SELL ON MATCH END
  - SELLS ALL YOUR UNITS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN THE MATCH FINISHES

* SELL ALL UNITS NOW
  - ONE BUTTON TO INSTANTLY SELL EVERYTHING ON THE FIELD

* PLACE DELAY
  - HOW FAST IT DROPS UNITS (0.05s UP TO 2s). LOWER = FASTER, HIGHER = SAFER

* UPGRADE DELAY
  - HOW FAST IT UPGRADES (0.1s UP TO 3s)

* KEEP YEN IN RESERVE
  - SET AN AMOUNT OF YEN IT WILL NEVER SPEND, SO YOU ALWAYS HAVE CASH LEFT (0 TO 5000)

# MATCHMAKING
* GAMEMODE PICKER
  - STORY, INFINITE, RAID, CHALLENGE, EVENT, EXPEDITION, MASTERY, VILLAIN INVASION

* AUTO REJOIN AFTER MATCH
  - AUTOMATICALLY RE-QUEUES YOU WHEN A MATCH ENDS SO IT FARMS ALL NIGHT
  - JUST QUEUE ONCE MANUALLY FIRST

* ENTER QUEUE / LEAVE QUEUE BUTTONS
  - JOIN OR CANCEL A QUEUE WITHOUT TOUCHING THE GAME MENU

* OPEN PLAY MENU
  - OPENS THE GAME'S PLAY SCREEN INSTANTLY

# UNITS
* ONLY PLACE THESE UNITS
  - PICK EXACTLY WHICH UNITS YOU WANT PLACED (MULTI-SELECT)
  - LEAVE IT EMPTY AND IT PLACES EVERYTHING IN YOUR HOTBAR

* SHOW MY HOTBAR
  - SHOWS ALL 6 SLOTS WITH EACH UNIT'S NAME, MAX PLACEMENTS, AND YEN COST

# PLACEMENT CONTROL
* PLACEMENT STRATEGY
  - ALONG PATH = HUGS THE ENEMY LANE FROM SPAWN ONWARD
  - NEAR TOWER = DEFENDS YOUR BASE POINT
  - SPREAD = SPREADS UNITS RANDOMLY ACROSS VALID SPOTS

* LANE SIDE
  - CHOOSE LEFT SIDE, RIGHT SIDE, OR BOTH SIDES OF THE PATH

* FACE TOWARD PATH
  - AUTO-TURNS EVERY UNIT TO FACE THE ENEMIES

* ROTATION OFFSET
  - EXTRA TURN OF 0, 90, 180 OR 270 DEGREES (SAME AS TAPPING R IN GAME)

* DISTANCE FROM PATH
  - HOW CLOSE TO THE LANE UNITS SIT (3 TO 30 STUDS)

* MAX SEARCH DISTANCE
  - HOW FAR OUT IT WILL LOOK IF THE CLOSE SPOT IS BLOCKED (6 TO 80 STUDS)

* LANE SAMPLING
  - HOW MANY SPOTS IT CHECKS ALONG THE LANE. LOWER = MORE SPOTS BUT SLOWER

* UNIT SPACING
  - HOW FAR APART YOUR UNITS STAND (3 TO 30 STUDS), STOPS THEM CLUMPING

* MAX PER UNIT
  - CAP HOW MANY COPIES OF EACH UNIT GET PLACED (0 = USE THE GAME'S OWN LIMIT)

* SCAN LEGAL SPOTS
  - COUNTS HOW MANY VALID PLACEMENT SPOTS EXIST ON THE MAP

* PREVIEW SPOTS
  - DRAWS MARKERS ON THE MAP SO YOU CAN SEE EXACTLY WHERE UNITS WILL GO
  - ORANGE MARKER SHOWS THE FACING DIRECTION

* CLEAR PREVIEW
  - REMOVES ALL THE MARKERS

# MISC & LIVE INFO
* REJOIN SERVER
  - ONE CLICK TO HOP INTO A FRESH SERVER

* PRINT STATE
  - DUMPS FULL MATCH INFO FOR TROUBLESHOOTING

* LIVE STATUS DISPLAY (UPDATES EVERY HALF SECOND)
  - CURRENT STATUS OF THE SCRIPT
  - WAVE NUMBER / MAX WAVE
  - YOUR BASE HP
  - YOUR CURRENT YEN
  - EVERY UNIT YOU HAVE PLACED AND HOW MANY

+ some features paid
